title: Customer-facing product name is still FindIt across ~60 files (111 occurrences) including the entire live legal corpus
location: src/lib/legalContent.js:16-398; src/pages/LegalPage.jsx:50-98; src/components/pwa/InstallPrompt.jsx:108; src/components/pwa/GlobalRefreshButton.jsx:20-30; src/components/auth/AccountBlocked.jsx:35; src/components/auth/GuestPromptSheet.jsx:19,41; src/components/AppErrorBoundary.jsx:31; src/components/layout/SiteFooter.jsx:32; src/components/layout/TopNav.jsx:43; src/components/listings/ContactButtons.jsx:157-250; src/components/settings/DeleteAccountSection.jsx:78

impact: Users see two different product names. The binding Terms and Privacy Policy name a product that is not the one being launched, weakening both brand trust and the enforceability/clarity of the legal agreement.
reproduction: Visit /legal/privacy, /legal/terms, trigger the install prompt, or open any listing detail contact sheet
root_cause: Rename was applied to shell/manifest/service-worker identity only; the body copy layer was never swept
recommended_fix: Sweep all user-visible strings to PeekaListing; keep --findit-* CSS tokens and __findit_* storage keys (compatibility). Extend the brand contract test to assert FindIt-absence repo-wide across src/**
test_to_prove_fix: Extend tests/peekaListingBrandContracts.test.mjs to walk all of src/ asserting no user-visible /FindIt/ outside CSS-var and storage-key allowlists

title: Public Peeks — the stated core differentiator — are gated off in every production configuration path in the repository and release acceptance is unevidenced
evidence: featureFlags.js:25 tours: stagingCertifiedFlag('VITE_FEATURE_TOURS'); App.jsx:171 route /peek rendered only when (tours || toursPreview); ENVIRONMENT_VARIABLES.md:27 'True only for an accepted Peek release'; TOURS_RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE.md:13 'in staging only'
impact: With the flag false the /peek route does not exist, so Public Peek discovery is absent from production. A product defined by Peeks would launch without them.
reproduction: Build with VITE_FEATURE_TOURS unset and navigate to /peek — PageNotFound
root_cause: Deliberate release gate pending Peek release acceptance; not a code defect
recommended_fix: Complete and evidence Peek release acceptance per docs/TOURS_RELEASE_ACCEPTANCE.md, then set the production flag; or make an explicit documented decision to launch without Public Peeks
test_to_prove_fix: Hosted check that /peek returns the Peek catalogue on the production origin
notes: Remedy is release acceptance not a code fix. Severity reflects launch-definition impact

title: Capability gating trusts a client-readable hostname prefix
evidence: STAGING_HOST_PREFIX='findit-marketplace-stagi'; isTrustedStagingHost() reads globalThis.location.hostname; resolveStagingCertifiedFlag returns isTrustedStagingEnvironment(env) || readBooleanFlag(...)
impact: Any deployment served from a hostname matching findit-marketplace-stagi*.vercel.app auto-enables messaging, notifications, Peeks and current-location regardless of build-time env. Trust decision is made from browser-visible state rather than build-time configuration.
reproduction: Serve the production bundle from a matching hostname; gated flags turn on
root_cause: Runtime hostname used as an authorization-adjacent trust signal
recommended_fix: Decide capabilities at build time from env only; drop the hostname branch
test_to_prove_fix: Unit test asserting isTrustedStagingEnvironment ignores location.hostname
notes: Impact is capability exposure not auth bypass

title: Node engine mismatch between declared requirement and installable range
evidence: engines.node '>=23.6.0'; audit environment Node v22.22.2 installed with npm warn EBADENGINE
impact: Declared engine is unenforced (no engine-strict, no .nvmrc). Scripts using --experimental-strip-types behave differently across 22/23, so local and CI runs can diverge from production builds.
reproduction: npm ci on Node 22 — succeeds with EBADENGINE warning
root_cause: Engine declared but not pinned or enforced
recommended_fix: Add .nvmrc / engine-strict and align CI setup-node with the declared version
test_to_prove_fix: CI job asserting node --version satisfies engines.node

title: Live Privacy Policy and Terms contain unfilled [TO BE COMPLETED] placeholders including operator legal name and registered address
evidence: legalContent.js:22 'operated by [TO BE COMPLETED: operator legal name], registered at [TO BE COMPLETED: registered address]'; :215 same in Terms; :116 '[TO BE COMPLETED: confirm exact retention periods...]'; :292 '[TO BE COMPLETED: confirm whether an aggregate liability cap...]'. src/lib/legalContentOverrides.js:1-11 overrides only two deletion/export paragraphs and does not touch these.
impact: The binding user agreement and privacy notice identify no operating entity and no address, and state no retention periods, on a marketplace that collects identity documents. Publishing in this state is a launch-gating legal exposure.
reproduction: Navigate to /legal/privacy and /legal/terms and read sections 1 and 11
root_cause: Legal copy drafted as a template and never completed before release certification
recommended_fix: Complete operator identity, address, retention periods and liability decision with counsel; then remove placeholder syntax
test_to_prove_fix: Contract test asserting no /\\[TO BE COMPLETED/ string is reachable from legalDocuments
